name: nodemelivre-monorepo
description: NodeMeLivre: SDK TypeScript modular para a API do Mercado Livre

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nodemelivre/errors && npm run build --workspace @nodemelivre/types && npm run build --workspace @nodemelivre/core && npm run build --workspace @nodemelivre/http && npm run build --workspace @nodemelivre/auth && npm run build --workspaces --if-present --workspace @nodemelivre/items --workspace @nodemelivre/orders --workspace @nodemelivre/users --workspace @nodemelivre/shipments --workspace @nodemelivre/questions --workspace @nodemelivre/images --workspace @nodemelivre/messages --workspace @nodemelivre/webhooks && npm run build --workspace @nodemelivre/sdk
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:examples
